# Pedulli / SRD

Exact lossless compression in one mode. Verification is by byte-exact restore and matching SHA-256.
The public compressor is locked; no file is uploaded. Private evaluations run server-side. The public origin contains no source code or executable implementation.

- Technology: https://pedulli.io/technology/
- Evidence (42 files, 4 corpora, 3 axes): https://pedulli.io/evidence/
- Security and control mapping: https://pedulli.io/security/
- CTO and company pilot: https://pedulli.io/pilot/
- Live dashboard: https://pedulli.io/dashboard/
- FAQ: https://pedulli.io/faq/
- About and CV: https://pedulli.io/about/
- Contact: francescopedulli@gmail.com

Internal work and intermediate results are private and are not described publicly.
